title: ArchMaker Artifact (DM-ARTIFACT, v0)
description: Material output of an exporter: ArchMaker profile, experimental archinstall profile or review report. Declares target, producer, versions, mediaType and digests (DEC-001, ADR-0003). Digests follow the canonicalization profile: binaryDigest is the SHA-256 of the exact artifact bytes; manifestRef carries the semantic contentDigest of the source manifest. Contract state: v0.
$comment: Contract v0 (phase R6, AUD-011/AUD-015). digest fields renamed to binaryDigest/contentDigest; shared $defs live in common.schema.json.

artifactRef.description: Identity of the artifact: binary digest and media type.

targetRef.description: Target that produced the artifact (DEC-001, DEC-008).

mediaType.description: IANA media type of the exported artifact.

binaryDigest.description: Binary digest of the exported artifact bytes (ADR-0007 decision 11).

manifestRef.description: Semantic digest of the source manifest.

experimental.description: True for experimental targets such as archinstall-profile (DEC-001).

content.description: Adapter-defined exported payload, versioned by targetRef.version (ADR-0003). Documented open payload: its shape is fixed by the target adapter, never by this contract. It must not contain executable fields, commands, hooks or shell.

artifactRef.description: Artifact identity: binary digest and media type.

manifestRef.description: Reference to the sealed source manifest.
